name: seis-ui-state-contract-audit
description: Audit bounded local UI source for explicit static loading, empty, degraded, offline, failure, approval, demo, and live-boundary state evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect static UI-state evidence and expose missing state markers.
interface.longDescription: Audits bounded local HTML, JavaScript, and CSS source for static loading, ready, empty, degraded, offline, unavailable, rate-limited, validation, provider-failure, approval, demo, and live-boundary markers. It never executes a UI or certifies runtime state transitions.
defaultPrompt: Audit this local SEIS UI source for static loading, empty, degraded, offline, failure, approval, demo, and live-boundary state evidence without executing a UI.
Show missing source state markers separately from runtime behavior that still needs human review.
